_note: Held Item catalog — all 19 of docs/design/catalogs/held-items.md. One slot per Pokémon, always on, wearer-only, swapped only in the Map View and kept until the run ends (§7.4.1). Releasing a Pokémon drops its item back to the bag rather than losing it. Ids differ from the same-named relics on purpose: the relic is party-wide and weaker, the item is one Pokémon and stronger (§7.4.2). `thick-club` is locked to Marowak and never enters a random pool (§7.4.6); Marowak is not in the build yet, so it is authored and unreachable rather than dropped from the file.
